note: Costs are 2026 US ballpark ranges for training/simulation realism. Tasks drive the notification engine. difficulty 1=easiest, 5=hardest. recommendedMinAge is a guideline for the real animal, not the app.

pets.name: Dog
pets.blurb: Loyal and loving but the highest daily commitment of common pets. Needs walks, training, and cleanup every single day.

tasks.label: Feed breakfast
tasks.realAction: Measure food, fill bowl, refresh water.
tasks.consequence: A hungry dog gets cranky and may chew things.

tasks.label: Feed dinner
tasks.realAction: Measure food, fill bowl.
tasks.consequence: Skipping meals harms growth and energy.

tasks.label: Refresh water
tasks.realAction: Dump old water, rinse bowl, refill fresh.

tasks.label: Morning walk
tasks.realAction: Leash up and walk 15-20 minutes.
tasks.consequence: No walk means accidents in the house and pent-up energy.

tasks.label: Evening walk
tasks.realAction: Leash up and walk 15-20 minutes.
tasks.consequence: Dogs need daily exercise to stay healthy.

tasks.label: Pick up poop in the yard
tasks.realAction: Take a bag, find the poop, scoop it, tie the bag, throw it in the trash. Wash hands.
tasks.consequence: Leaving poop attracts flies, smells, and is unhealthy.

tasks.label: Play / training time
tasks.realAction: Fetch, tug, or practice a command for 10 minutes.

tasks.label: Brush coat
tasks.realAction: Brush fur to remove loose hair and check for ticks.

tasks.label: Bath
tasks.realAction: Wet, shampoo, rinse, towel dry.

tasks.label: Nail trim
tasks.realAction: Ask a grown-up to trim or file nails.
tasks.consequence: Long nails hurt the dog's paws.

tasks.label: Vet checkup
tasks.realAction: Annual exam, vaccines, weigh-in.
tasks.consequence: Missed checkups let illness go unnoticed.

pets.name: Cat
pets.blurb: More independent than a dog but the litter box is a daily, non-negotiable job.

tasks.label: Feed breakfast
tasks.realAction: Measure food, fill bowl.
tasks.consequence: Hungry cats meow and beg all day.

tasks.label: Feed dinner
tasks.realAction: Measure food, fill bowl.

tasks.label: Refresh water
tasks.realAction: Fresh water daily.
tasks.consequence: Cats avoid dirty water and can get dehydrated.

tasks.label: Scoop the litter box
tasks.realAction: Scoop clumps into a bag, tie it, throw it away. Wash hands.
tasks.consequence: A dirty box makes the cat pee outside it.

tasks.label: Play time
tasks.realAction: Wand toy or laser for 10 minutes.

tasks.label: Full litter change
tasks.realAction: Dump all litter, wash the box, add fresh litter.

tasks.label: Brush coat
tasks.realAction: Brush to reduce hairballs and shedding.

tasks.label: Nail trim
tasks.realAction: Grown-up helps trim nails.

tasks.label: Vet checkup
tasks.realAction: Annual exam and vaccines.

pets.name: Rabbit
pets.blurb: Quiet and soft but needs a big clean space, daily hay, and gentle handling.

tasks.label: Refill hay
tasks.realAction: Top up unlimited fresh hay.
tasks.consequence: Rabbits must eat hay constantly or their tummy stops working.

tasks.label: Fresh water
tasks.realAction: Clean and refill water bottle.

tasks.label: Give fresh greens
tasks.realAction: A handful of washed leafy greens.

tasks.label: Spot-clean litter corner
tasks.realAction: Scoop the dirty corner, wash hands.

tasks.label: Out-of-pen play
tasks.realAction: Supervised hop time in a safe space.

tasks.label: Deep clean hutch
tasks.realAction: Replace all bedding, scrub the floor.

tasks.label: Brush fur
tasks.realAction: Brush gently, especially when shedding.
tasks.consequence: Swallowed fur can block their gut.

tasks.label: Nail trim
tasks.realAction: Grown-up trims nails.

tasks.label: Vet checkup
tasks.realAction: Exotic vet exam.

pets.name: Hamster
pets.blurb: Small, cheap, and nocturnal. A good starter pet but still needs daily care and a weekly cage clean.

tasks.label: Refill food
tasks.realAction: Top up the food dish in the evening.

tasks.label: Check water bottle
tasks.realAction: Make sure the bottle works and is full.
tasks.consequence: A stuck bottle means no water.

tasks.label: Spot-clean potty corner
tasks.realAction: Scoop the wet corner.

tasks.label: Gentle handling
tasks.realAction: Let it come to your hand, hold low over a soft surface.

tasks.label: Full cage clean
tasks.realAction: Replace bedding, wash dishes and wheel.

pets.name: Guinea Pig
pets.blurb: Social and vocal, best kept in pairs. Needs daily hay, vitamin C, and frequent cleaning.

tasks.label: Refill hay
tasks.realAction: Unlimited fresh hay.

tasks.label: Fresh water
tasks.realAction: Clean and refill bottle.

tasks.label: Vitamin C veggies
tasks.realAction: Bell pepper or leafy greens daily.
tasks.consequence: Guinea pigs get sick without vitamin C.

tasks.label: Spot-clean cage
tasks.realAction: Remove wet bedding and droppings.

tasks.label: Floor time / cuddle
tasks.realAction: Supervised lap or pen time.

tasks.label: Full cage clean
tasks.realAction: Replace all bedding, wash the cage.

tasks.label: Vet checkup
tasks.realAction: Exotic vet exam.

pets.name: Fish (Freshwater Tank)
pets.blurb: Looks easy but water chemistry is the real job. Overfeeding is the number one killer.

tasks.label: Feed fish (small pinch)
tasks.realAction: A tiny pinch they finish in 2 minutes. No more.
tasks.consequence: Overfeeding fouls the water and kills fish.

tasks.label: Check fish + temperature
tasks.realAction: Count the fish, watch how they swim, read the thermometer.

tasks.label: Test water
tasks.realAction: Test ammonia, nitrite, pH with the kit.

tasks.label: 25% water change
tasks.realAction: Siphon out a quarter, add conditioned water of the same temperature.
tasks.consequence: Waste builds up and harms fish.

tasks.label: Wipe glass + check filter
tasks.realAction: Wipe algae, make sure the filter flows.

tasks.label: Rinse/replace filter media
tasks.realAction: Rinse media in tank water, replace if clogged.

pets.name: Betta Fish
pets.blurb: A great solo starter fish, but it still needs a heated, filtered 5 gallon tank, not a tiny bowl.

tasks.label: Feed 2-3 pellets
tasks.realAction: Just 2-3 pellets. One fast day per week is healthy.
tasks.consequence: Overfeeding causes bloat and dirty water.

tasks.label: Check temperature + fish
tasks.realAction: Heater should hold 78-80F.
tasks.consequence: Cold bettas get sluggish and sick.

tasks.label: 25% water change
tasks.realAction: Swap a quarter of the water with conditioned, temp-matched water.

tasks.label: Test water
tasks.realAction: Dip a test strip, check the chart.

pets.name: Parakeet / Budgie
pets.blurb: Smart, social birds best kept in pairs. Daily cage cleaning and lots of interaction.

tasks.label: Fresh food
tasks.realAction: Empty seed hulls, refill with fresh food.
tasks.consequence: Empty hulls look full but starve the bird.

tasks.label: Fresh water
tasks.realAction: Clean and refill water cup.

tasks.label: Change cage liner
tasks.realAction: Swap the paper liner at the bottom.

tasks.label: Talk / play time
tasks.realAction: Talk, whistle, or supervised out-of-cage time.

tasks.label: Deep clean cage
tasks.realAction: Wash bars, perches, dishes, and toys.

tasks.label: Avian vet checkup
tasks.realAction: Yearly exam with a bird vet.

pets.name: Turtle (Aquatic)
pets.blurb: A decades-long commitment with serious tank, heat, and UVB needs. Can carry salmonella so hand-washing is critical.

tasks.label: Feed turtle
tasks.realAction: Feed a portion the size of its head. Wash hands after.

tasks.label: Check heat + UVB lamps
tasks.realAction: Basking spot 90F, water 75-78F, lamps on a timer.
tasks.consequence: Cold turtles get sick; no UVB causes shell disease.

tasks.label: Skim uneaten food
tasks.realAction: Net out leftover food.

tasks.label: 25% water change
tasks.realAction: Siphon and replace a quarter with conditioned water.
tasks.consequence: Dirty water causes shell and eye infections.

tasks.label: Clean filter + dock
tasks.realAction: Rinse filter media, scrub the basking dock.

tasks.label: Replace UVB bulb
tasks.realAction: UVB output fades; replace yearly even if it still lights.
tasks.consequence: Invisible UVB loss leads to bone disease.

tasks.label: Vet checkup
tasks.realAction: Reptile vet exam.

pets.name: Leopard Gecko
pets.blurb: A calm, hardy reptile but needs live insects, correct heat, and a humid hide for shedding.

tasks.label: Fresh water + check humidity
tasks.realAction: Refresh the water dish, mist the humid hide.

tasks.label: Check temperatures
tasks.realAction: Warm side ~90F, cool side ~75F.

tasks.label: Feed dusted insects
tasks.realAction: Offer calcium-dusted insects (young geckos daily, adults every other day).

tasks.label: Spot-clean poop
tasks.realAction: Remove droppings from the potty corner.

tasks.label: Clean enclosure
tasks.realAction: Wipe surfaces, wash hides and dish.

tasks.label: Vet checkup
tasks.realAction: Reptile vet exam.

pets.name: Tortoise
pets.blurb: A lifelong, even multi-generational pet. Needs a large space, UVB, and a constant supply of greens.

tasks.label: Fresh greens
tasks.realAction: A salad of safe greens and weeds.

tasks.label: Fresh water + soak
tasks.realAction: Clean water dish; young tortoises soak a few times a week.

tasks.label: Check UVB + heat
tasks.realAction: Basking ~95F, lamps on a timer.
tasks.consequence: No UVB means soft, deformed shell.

tasks.label: Spot-clean enclosure
tasks.realAction: Remove waste and old food.

tasks.label: Deep clean enclosure
tasks.realAction: Replace soiled substrate, scrub dishes.

tasks.label: Replace UVB bulb
tasks.realAction: Replace yearly.
tasks.consequence: Invisible UVB loss harms the shell.

tasks.label: Vet checkup
tasks.realAction: Reptile vet exam.

pets.name: Backyard Chickens
pets.blurb: Fun and rewarding with fresh eggs, but daily letting-out, locking-up, and coop cleaning are essential, plus predator safety.

tasks.label: Open the coop
tasks.realAction: Let the hens out into the run at sunrise.

tasks.label: Feed + fresh water
tasks.realAction: Fill feeder and clean waterer.
tasks.consequence: Hens stop laying without food and water.

tasks.label: Collect eggs
tasks.realAction: Gather eggs from the nesting boxes.
tasks.consequence: Left eggs get broken or eaten.

tasks.label: Lock up the coop
tasks.realAction: Count the birds and lock the door at dusk.
tasks.consequence: Open coops let predators in overnight.

tasks.label: Tidy the run
tasks.realAction: Rake droppings, check fencing.

tasks.label: Deep clean coop
tasks.realAction: Replace bedding, scrub nesting boxes.

tasks.label: Health + predator check
tasks.realAction: Check each bird and inspect fencing for gaps.
tasks.consequence: Missed illness or a weak spot in the fence.

pets.name: Tarantula
pets.blurb: Low daily effort and fascinating, but a hands-off, observation pet. Teaches patience and respect, not cuddling.

tasks.label: Check water dish
tasks.realAction: Keep the small dish full of clean water.

tasks.label: Observe + check humidity
tasks.realAction: Look but do not handle. Note if it is hiding to molt.
tasks.consequence: Disturbing a molting spider can kill it.

tasks.label: Feed insects
tasks.realAction: Offer 1-3 insects weekly. Remove uneaten prey. Do not feed while molting.
tasks.consequence: Leftover crickets can hurt the spider.

tasks.label: Tidy enclosure
tasks.realAction: Remove boluses (food leftovers) and old molts.
